nodes.name: JwtService
nodes.summary: Service responsible for JWT access-token generation, claim extraction, validation, and signing-key resolution.

nodes.name: generateAccessToken
nodes.summary: Builds a signed JWT access token containing subject, user id, roles, token type, token version, id, issued-at, and expiration claims.

nodes.name: extractUsername
nodes.summary: Parses a JWT and returns its subject as the authenticated username.

nodes.name: extractTokenVersion
nodes.summary: Reads the tokenVersion claim from a JWT for access-token invalidation checks.

nodes.name: isTokenValid
nodes.summary: Validates a JWT as an access token for the supplied user details and checks expiration.

nodes.name: resolveKeyBytes
nodes.summary: Decodes a Base64 JWT secret when possible and falls back to SHA-256 hashing for plain-text local secrets.

nodes.name: MyUserDetailsService
nodes.summary: Spring Security user-details service that loads users by username and wraps them as UserPrincipal.

nodes.name: loadUserByUsername
nodes.summary: Loads a user by username and converts it to UserPrincipal for Spring Security authentication.

nodes.name: RefreshTokenService
nodes.summary: Transactional service for issuing, rotating, and revoking opaque refresh tokens.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates and persists a new opaque refresh token for a user with configured expiration.

nodes.name: verifyAndRotate
nodes.summary: Validates a refresh token, rejects missing or unusable tokens, revokes the current token, and issues a replacement.

nodes.name: revoke
nodes.summary: Marks a refresh token as revoked when a nonblank raw token is supplied.

nodes.name: revokeSessionAndBump
nodes.summary: Revokes the current refresh token and increments the user token version to invalidate existing access tokens.

nodes.name: revokeAllRefreshTokens
nodes.summary: Revokes all stored refresh tokens for a user without directly changing the token version.

nodes.summary: Concrete user-management service coordinating repositories, password encoding, role assignment, customer profiles, avatar storage, cache eviction, and refresh-token revocation.

nodes.name: savedUser
nodes.summary: Registers a new customer user after email and username uniqueness checks, assigns the CUSTOMER role, creates a customer profile, and initializes a cart.

nodes.name: getAllUsers
nodes.summary: Returns paginated users mapped to responses with caching for admin listing.

nodes.name: getUserById
nodes.summary: Loads a user by id or raises a not-found error, then maps the entity to a response.

nodes.name: getUserByEmail
nodes.summary: Loads a user by email and maps it to a response for account lookup.

nodes.name: getActiveUsers
nodes.summary: Returns paginated active users mapped to response DTOs with cache support.

nodes.name: updateUser
nodes.summary: Applies admin user updates, validates role changes, updates profile fields, and invalidates tokens when password or active status changes.

nodes.name: updateProfile
nodes.summary: Applies self-service profile updates with uniqueness checks and revokes refresh tokens when the password changes.

nodes.name: updateAvatar
nodes.summary: Replaces a user avatar by deleting an old local file, storing the uploaded image, and updating the customer profile URL.

nodes.name: uploadAvatar
nodes.summary: Validates a nullable user id wrapper and delegates to avatar replacement.

nodes.name: deleteUserById
nodes.summary: Deletes a user by id through the repository.

nodes.name: getOrCreateCustomer
nodes.summary: Returns the user customer profile or creates a default browser-level profile attached to the managed user.

nodes.name: resolveRoles
nodes.summary: Loads requested roles in input order and raises a not-found error for unknown role ids.

nodes.name: getWishlistsByUserId
nodes.summary: Returns a user wishlist as response DTOs using cached read-only repository data.

nodes.name: removeItemFromWishlist
nodes.summary: Finds a user-product wishlist entry, raises not-found when absent, and deletes it.
